Hi Stephen,

I'm sorry. You sent the photos and filed the RMA, and since Georges wrote to you on October 16 you have had nothing back from us. That is on us, and you have been without a working miner for too long.

Here is where it actually stands, honestly. Your NerdOctaxe from order Shop···· was delivered on August 26, and on our side your RMA has not been approved yet, which is why no return label has reached you. I have put it in front of JD and Georges with everything you have already sent, so nobody asks you for it twice. They are offline right now and pick this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you here by email. Once it is approved I will send you the prepaid return label myself, with the reference Shop···· to write on the box.

One thing that may get you a faster technical read in the meantime: our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. JD is there as @nullhashrate and is very active, so you can post the photos and the error there and he will look at them directly.

Thanks for your patience on this, Stephen, and sorry again for the silence.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
